claims.claim_text: As of Dec 31 2025 DLR's portfolio included 310 data centers (118 US, 113 Europe, 36 LatAm, 16 Africa, 18 Asia, 6 Australia, 3 Canada) totaling ~57.6M rentable sq ft, 84.7% leased, on a managed-portfolio basis.
claims.subject: Digital Realty Trust
claims.source_quote: our portfolio included 310 data centers ... approximately 57.6 million rentable square feet ... was approximately 84.7% leased.

claims.claim_text: DLR claims 769 MW of projects underway across multiple metros as of Dec 31 2025, with 64% pre-leased; ~2.9 GW total in-place IT capacity and 5 GW of future development capacity.
claims.subject: Digital Realty Trust
claims.object_value: 769 MW underway / 64% pre-leased / 2.9 GW in-place / 5 GW future
claims.source_quote: we had 769 megawatts of projects underway across multiple metropolitan areas around the world, and 64% of this data center activity was pre-leased ... ~2.9 GW of total in-place IT capacity to meet growing demand, with ~770 MW under construction and 5 GW of future development capacity

claims.claim_text: Oracle Corporation is DLR's second-largest customer at 42 locations, $424.1M annualized recurring revenue (9.0% of total), 10.2 year weighted-average remaining lease term as of Dec 31 2025.
claims.subject: Oracle Corporation

claims.claim_text: Meta Platforms is DLR's #8 customer with 49 locations, $73.5M ARR (1.6%), 2.8yr WALT as of Dec 31 2025.
claims.subject: Meta Platforms, Inc.

claims.claim_text: DLR's largest customer (unnamed 'Fortune 50 Software Company') accounted for 11.7% of aggregate annualized recurring revenue across 76 locations with $547M ARR and 9.4yr WALT as of Dec 31 2025.
claims.subject: Unnamed Fortune 50 Software Company (likely Microsoft)

claims.claim_text: In Jan 2024 DLR formed a 20%-retained JV with Blackstone to develop four hyperscale data center campuses across Frankfurt, Paris and Northern Virginia, supporting construction of 10 data centers with ~500 MW potential IT-load; total estimated development cost first phase ~$3.0B.
claims.subject: Digital Realty / Blackstone JV
claims.object_value: 10 data centers, ~500 MW, $3.0B Phase 1 development cost; DLR retained 20% interest
claims.source_quote: we formed a joint venture with Blackstone Inc. to develop four hyperscale data center campuses across Frankfurt, Paris and Northern Virginia. The campuses are planned to support the construction of 10 data centers with approximately 500 megawatts of potential IT load capacity ... Each partner funded its pro rata share of the remaining $3.0 billion estimated development cost for the first phase

claims.claim_text: DLR had $3,451.6M cash & equivalents as of Dec 31 2025; $18.557B total outstanding debt ($17.110B fixed-rate inclusive of swaps; $1.447B variable). Expects $3.25B-$3.75B capex in FY2026.
claims.subject: Digital Realty Trust
claims.source_quote: $3,451.6 million of cash and cash equivalents ... Total outstanding debt $ 18,557 ... approximately $3.25 billion to $3.75 billion of capital expenditures

claims.claim_text: DLR estimates its land and other space could accommodate >3,500 MW of additional data-center capacity including >1,000 MW developable in Northern Virginia.
claims.subject: Digital Realty Trust
claims.object_value: >3,500 MW future capacity; >1,000 MW Northern Virginia
claims.source_quote: land and other space held for, or actively under, construction could accommodate over 3,500 megawatts of additional data center capacity, including more than 1,000 additional megawatts developable in Northern Virginia
